The question asks which music records are *still* illegal in France.  
Historically France did ban a few individual songs or albums (e.g., certain “obscene” or “subversive” titles in the 1960‑70s), but those bans have been lifted.  Modern French law does not maintain a list of specific records that are illegal; only content that violates general statutes (hate speech, incitement to violence, etc.) can be prohibited, and no well‑known commercial releases fall under that category today.  

Therefore, essentially no specific music records remain illegal in France – “very few (if any)” is the accurate description.

**Final answer: (B) Very few (if any) music records are still illegal in France**
